nodes.label: F-0001: Engine.dll export RVA is a thunk
nodes.norm_label: f-0001: engine.dll export rva is a thunk
nodes.rationale: Rule: Resolve export, follow jmp, validate target as function entry. Never hook Engine.dll export address directly because incremental linking uses jump-thunks that miss internal calls.

nodes.label: F-0007: IDirect3D9::CreateDevice hook silent
nodes.rationale: Rule: Resolve engine-facing D3D9 functions from the actual device the game uses, not a convenience device. D3D9 provides different implementations (Present/Draw) based on presentation parameters.

nodes.label: F-0013: UViewport::Exec 'this' pointer offset
nodes.rationale: Rule: In multiple-inheritance, exported methods expect the subobject pointer, not the base object pointer. Prefer calling through vtable slots.

nodes.label: F-0019: Vtable location vs target
nodes.rationale: Rule: COM identity is where vtable entries point. D3D9 uses heap vtables. Print values before theorizing.

nodes.label: F-0018: D3D9 device hooks never fired
nodes.norm_label: f-0018: d3d9 device hooks never fired
nodes.rationale: Rule: Do not build on D3D9 observer until resolved. Engine hooks (Draw) are independent of D3D9 layer hooks.

nodes.label: F-0025: 9On12 Device Creation Failure
nodes.rationale: Rule: Invert ownership—let 9On12 create the D3D12 device and adopt it, rather than handing it a pre-created one. Simulator environment (LUIDs) is part of the simulation.

nodes.label: D3D9On12 Device Ownership
nodes.rationale: Game must own the D3D9 device; the mod adopts the underlying D3D12 device/queue from it.

nodes.label: R1: D3D9 to OpenXR Interop
nodes.rationale: Falsified D3D9Ex substitution due to D3DPOOL_MANAGED usage; validated Route B (D3D9 -> 9On12 -> D3D12).

nodes.label: Engine FOV (Horizontal)
nodes.rationale: Verified as horizontal degrees via projection matrix m00 analysis and ini cross-check.

nodes.label: BUILD_HISTORY.md
nodes.rationale: Build tracking, versioning contract, and hash logs.

nodes.label: VR_FINDINGS_INDEX.md
nodes.rationale: Central index mapping topics to specific documentation owners.

nodes.label: Left-handed Coordinate System
nodes.rationale: Decoded from the D3D9 projection matrix.

nodes.label: Exported Name Resolution
nodes.rationale: Engine.dll exports ~7.6k symbols; using GetProcAddress + thunk following is more robust than byte patterns.

nodes.label: R1 — OpenXR D3D9 Interop
nodes.rationale: Validated Direct3DCreate9On12 as the primary transport mechanism for D3D9 frames to OpenXR swapchains.

nodes.label: R2 — 32-bit OpenXR Runtime Support
nodes.rationale: Confirmed 32-bit OpenXR apps run under VirtualDesktopXR; SteamVR remains a secondary target.

nodes.label: R3 — Renderer Pipeline Analysis
nodes.rationale: Identified hybrid pipeline (fixed-function + shaders) using apitrace; RTCShader.dll handles programmable path.

nodes.label: R4 — Scene-Draw Re-entry
nodes.rationale: Confirmed UGameEngine::Draw can be called twice per frame to produce stereo pixels.

nodes.label: R6 — Threading Model
nodes.rationale: Verified engine is single-threaded across render seams, simplifying re-entrancy.

nodes.label: F-0002: Camera seam has no standard prologue
nodes.norm_label: f-0002: camera seam has no standard prologue
nodes.rationale: Rule: Do not derive function starts by prologue scanning (no 55 8B EC). Use export table or CC-padding between functions.

nodes.label: F-0003: Intermittent CreateDevice failure with VR
nodes.norm_label: f-0003: intermittent createdevice failure with vr
nodes.rationale: Rule: Sample repeatedly and report rate (FLAKY: n/5) when results vary with ambient machine state.

nodes.label: F-0004: Vtable provenance false alarm
nodes.rationale: Rule: Provenance is about where function pointers point, not where the pointer array (vtable) lives (which can be on the heap).

nodes.label: F-0005: Overstating 'MANAGED' asset path
nodes.rationale: Rule: 'X happens' != 'X is the norm'. Use subset counters to support claims about subsets.

nodes.label: F-0006: Wrong Swat4X.ini path
nodes.rationale: Rule: CWD, not the exe folder, determines which files UE2 loads. Mod must log config identity (path, mtime, hash).

nodes.label: F-0008: Bidirectional GUI Resolution Field
nodes.rationale: Rule: Read the whole class, not just the getter. A getter proves a field is written to, not that it isn't also read from (bidirectional).

nodes.label: F-0009: R6 verdict inverted data
nodes.rationale: Rule: Capture live, report at exit. DLL_PROCESS_DETACH samples a half-torn-down process (e.g., window already destroyed).

nodes.label: F-0010: Swallowed engine exceptions
nodes.rationale: Rule: One fault disables the bridge for the session. Fail closed and diagnose offline. Read past our own frames in engine crash history.

nodes.label: F-0011: .gitignore excluded src/game/
nodes.rationale: Rule: Anchor ignore rules (e.g., /game/). Verify repository content with git ls-files, not just commit success.

nodes.label: F-0012: Disk full from apitrace
nodes.rationale: Rule: Check free space and pin output path for unbounded captures. A full disk causes silent write failures in unrelated components (config corruption).

nodes.label: F-0014: B1 precondition gate failure
nodes.rationale: Rule: Gates must assert required rates, not just non-zero. Reset cumulative counters on arm for point-in-time measurements.

nodes.label: F-0015: Screenshot timing bug
nodes.rationale: Rule: Sample the proof after the thing it proves. Human observation (flicker) trumps silent instrument reporting no change.

nodes.label: B1 Pixel Proof
nodes.rationale: Instrumented test comparing stock, doubled-control, and doubled-yawed frames to validate re-entry.

nodes.label: Sequential Re-entry Architecture
nodes.rationale: Proven via B1 pixel proof; doubling UGameEngine::Draw with camera offsets produces valid stereo pairs.

nodes.label: F-0016: Python append-truncation bug
nodes.rationale: Rule: Never write to a file while still reading it in the same expression. Assert on preserved content, not just added content.

nodes.label: F-0017: Command file overwrite
nodes.rationale: Rule: Polled files are lossy. Wait for consumption or queue commands. Verify all commands echoed, not just the last one.

nodes.label: F-0020: Burst comparator lag-1 vs lag-2
nodes.norm_label: f-0020: burst comparator lag-1 vs lag-2
nodes.rationale: Rule: Work out expected signal (lag-2 for alternation) before writing tests. A 'measures nothing' verdict needs scrutiny.

nodes.label: F-0021: Burst crash in-mission
nodes.rationale: Rule: One mutation at a time. Framebuffer readback is a mutation (stalls pipeline). Menu success != in-mission success.

nodes.label: F-0022: /OPT:ICF folding misdiagnosis
nodes.rationale: Rule: Verification instruments must be as capable as the mechanism under test (e.g., follow multiple thunk hops).

nodes.label: F-0023: git checkout destroyed work
nodes.rationale: Rule: Restore from in-memory original, not git HEAD, during mutation testing to preserve uncommitted work.

nodes.label: F-0024: OpenXR event pump deadlock
nodes.rationale: Rule: A gate must not be the only caller of the thing that opens it. Pump events before checking session status.

nodes.label: F-0026: Stale Build Injection
nodes.rationale: Stale DLLs from different configurations were being injected because launcher defaults pointed to non-produced directories.

nodes.label: F-0027: Swapchain Rebuild Thrash
nodes.rationale: Comparing game format against runtime-chosen format caused per-frame swapchain rebuilds when they didn't match.

nodes.label: F-0028: Focus-Induced False Hangs
nodes.rationale: UE2.5 stops rendering when unfocused, leading to misdiagnosis of hangs and engine properties.

nodes.label: F-0029: Alt-Tab D3DPOOL_DEFAULT Fatal
nodes.rationale: Resources in D3DPOOL_DEFAULT must be released before Reset; failure to do so freezes the game on regaining focus.

nodes.label: D3D9On12 Interop
nodes.rationale: Chosen because D3D9Ex rejects D3DPOOL_MANAGED, which 98% of SWAT 4 textures use.

nodes.label: M1.2: Observation
nodes.rationale: Achieved via Engine.dll exports rather than D3D9 hooks.

nodes.rationale: Gates runs based on proven mission entry and valid projection data.

nodes.label: autotest.ps1
nodes.rationale: Orchestrates unattended testing, map loading, and census validation.

nodes.rationale: External API layer for recording and checking OpenXR submissions.

nodes.label: Correctness by Cancellation
nodes.rationale: Opposite right-vectors in eyeOffsetUU and headOffsetUU result in correct percept; do not 'tidy' without locating the second inversion.

nodes.label: Device Loss Recovery
nodes.rationale: Poll state from Present, not TestCooperativeLevel, as the engine may stop calling the latter.

nodes.label: HUD Cropping vs Scaling
nodes.rationale: Screen-space HUD is cropped when game FOV > headset FOV; fix by scaling at tile-draw call.

nodes.label: OpenXR FOV Submission Law
nodes.rationale: FOV describes the rendered frustum, it does not request it; incorrect declaration causes divergence.

nodes.label: Signature-based Offset Discovery
nodes.rationale: Use float/int patterns (e.g., {0,0,W,H}) to find UCanvas dimensions rather than hardcoded offsets.

nodes.label: RE Anchor Ladder
nodes.rationale: Prioritizes reflection (R1) and native tables (R1b) over byte-patterns (R6).

nodes.label: Exit Counters vs Entry Counters
nodes.rationale: Distinguishes between 'hook never fired' and 'hook fired but bailed' by counting at every exit point.

nodes.label: Mutation Testing (mutate.py)
nodes.rationale: Proves a test suite can fail; identifies vacuous tests that pass for the wrong reasons.
